### ✨ New
- 🔍 Search any tool from the home screen: type part of its name, what it does or its radio, accents and case aside
- 📡 Spectrum analyser, more room for the plot:
  - 📍 The header line is gone: the peak shows at the foot of the spectrum
  - 🎛️ Under the waterfall: move, zoom out and in, and the centre frequency to the 100 Hz; a tap on it types a frequency in a window the keyboard cannot hide
  - 🏷️ The marker shows its frequency to the 100 Hz, with a new button to make it the centre
  - 🖐️ Sliding a finger along the waterfall moves the marker, as on the spectrum
- ♿ Screen readers: icons now say what they do (Back, Close, Next…), and icon buttons are announced as buttons

### 🐛 Bug fixes
- 🔌 PlutoSDR not recognised: it is now found by its USB ids, with ADI's firmware and with Tezuka, and plugging it in offers to open the app
- 🌊 The spectrum and the waterfall drifted apart at the edges, on tablets most of all: they now line up
- 📜 Long lists left their last rows blank for a moment before showing them
- ↩️ Closing a page with the back gesture made it bounce, and reopening one while it closed made it jump
- 🗣️ Screen readers read icons by their font names ("arrow_back")
- 💬 The confirmation message floated too high inside tools, could not be tapped away, and its OK was not translated

### 🧰 Other
- 🎬 Smoother Start/Stop button, page titles and progress bars
